pageTitle: cyWhat are your grounds for possession?
heading: cyWhat are your grounds for possession?
paragraphs: cySelect the grounds you want to use for this claim. These may be the same grounds you included in the notice you served, or additional grounds you want to rely on since serving it.
cyRead guidance about possession grounds (opens in new tab).

mandatory.hint: cyIf you make a claim on mandatory grounds, the court will accept your reasons for possession if they can be proven. Select all that apply.

discretionary.hint: cyIf you make a claim on discretionary grounds, a judge will decide whether possession is reasonable. Select all that apply.
